[!isolates] skip
# Ownership probes are GC safepoints. Large comma-ok type assertions must not
# expose an uninitialized pointer temporary when a probe grows the stack.
go build -gcflags=example.com/assert-gc=-d=isolateheap=2 -o check$GOEXE .
exec ./check$GOEXE
stdout '^aggregate type assertions survived stack growth and GC$'
[race] go build -race -gcflags=example.com/assert-gc=-d=isolateheap=2 -o check-race$GOEXE .
[race] exec ./check-race$GOEXE
[race] stdout '^aggregate type assertions survived stack growth and GC$'
go test -gcflags=example.com/assert-gc=-d=isolateheap=2 -count=20 .
[race] go test -race -gcflags=example.com/assert-gc=-d=isolateheap=2 -count=20 .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/assert-gc
go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"
)

type record struct {
	Pointers [32]*int
	Words    [32]uintptr
}

//go:noinline
func poison(depth int) {
	var words [256]uintptr
	for i := range words {
		words[i] = 8
	}
	if depth > 0 {
		poison(depth - 1)
	}
	runtime.KeepAlive(&words)
}

//go:noinline
func assert(value any) (record, bool) {
	result, ok := value.(record)
	return result, ok
}

func main() {
	debug.SetGCPercent(1)
	for i := 0; i < 1000; i++ {
		done := make(chan struct{})
		go func() {
			poison(3)
			value := new(int)
			*value = 17
			original := record{}
			original.Pointers[0] = value
			original.Words[0] = 8
			got, ok := assert(original)
			if !ok || got != original {
				panic("successful assertion changed value")
			}
			got, ok = assert("different type")
			if ok || got != (record{}) {
				panic("failed assertion did not return zero")
			}
			close(done)
		}()
		<-done
	}
	fmt.Println("aggregate type assertions survived stack growth and GC")
}
-- factory_test.go --
package main

import (
	"isolate"
	"runtime/debug"
	"testing"
)

type factory struct {
	Callback func() []byte
	Replay   bool
	Lookup   func(string) any
	Dynamic  bool
	Program  isolate.Program
	Name     string
	Function isolate.Handle
	Hooks    [9]func()
}

type configuration struct{ value []byte }

func (c *configuration) snapshot() []byte { return append([]byte(nil), c.value...) }

//go:noinline
func wrap(value any, c *configuration) any {
	if result, ok := value.(factory); ok {
		result.Callback = c.snapshot
		return result
	}
	return value
}

func TestFactorySnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	previous := debug.SetGCPercent(1)
	defer debug.SetGCPercent(previous)
	input := []byte("first")
	c := configuration{value: input}
	first := c.snapshot()
	first[0] = 'x'
	if string(c.snapshot()) != "first" {
		t.Fatal("snapshot aliased input")
	}
	f := wrap(factory{}, &c).(factory)
	c.value = []byte("later")
	if string(f.Callback()) != "later" {
		t.Fatal("factory lost configuration")
	}
	if got := wrap("unmatched", &c); got != "unmatched" {
		t.Fatal("failed assertion changed interface")
	}
}
